payload.title: Reduce interactive Console response latency
payload.description:
Purpose: make interactive Console responses begin promptly while preserving the single supported Tactus execution path.

Definition of Done:
- Plexus uses released Tactus APIs instead of runtime method replacement.
- Provisioned instances preload the exact LLM adapter stack.
- Latency telemetry separates preparation, model initialization, provider first chunk, and streaming.
- Sandbox and production measurements meet the agreed first-token target.
